cues.en: The intermediate value theorem is pretty straightforward, but it's something that you need to know by name.
cues.zh: 介值定理很直接，但你必須知道這個名稱。

cues.en: So this will be an important video, but I hope it's not one that you struggle with.
cues.zh: 所以這支重要，但希望不會讓你掙扎。

cues.en: The intermediate value theorem is about the values that a function can take on between two x axis points.
cues.zh: 介值定理談的是，函數在兩個 x 軸點之間，能取哪些值。

cues.en: So here you see a function in blue and two x axis values A and B, and these are the Y axis values corresponding
cues.zh: 藍色是函數，x 軸有 a、b，這些是對應的，

cues.en: to points A and B, and we can call those values F of A and F of B.
cues.zh: y 軸值，叫 f(a)、f(b)。

cues.en: So whatever this function is, if you plug in A, you're going to get this value.
cues.zh: 不管函數是什麼，代 a，就得到這個值。

cues.en: And if you plug in B, you're going to get this value.
cues.zh: 代 b，得到那個值。

cues.en: The intermediate value theorem tells us that any value, any y axis value between A or F of A and F
cues.zh: 介值定理說，介於 f(a) 和 f，

cues.en: of B has a corresponding x axis value that produces that function output that is between points A and points B.
cues.zh: (b) 之間的任何 y 值，都有某個 a、b 之間的 x，產生該輸出。

cues.en: So anywhere between this point and at this point or any number between this number and this number has a corresponding x axis coordinate somewhere between this number and this number.
cues.zh: 所以兩點、兩個數字之間任何值，都有對應 x 座標，在這兩個 x 之間。

cues.en: So let me make this a little bit clear with a concrete example.
cues.zh: 用具體例子說清楚。

cues.en: Let's take the function X squared.
cues.zh: 取 x²。

cues.en: So pretty straightforward function and let's take a point A to B two and point B to B four.
cues.zh: 很直接，a=2，b=4。

cues.en: So this means that F of A is four and F of B is 16.
Now this here, this is referred to as the interval.
cues.zh: 這裡叫區間。

cues.en: You will see this term come up many times in calculus.
cues.zh: 微積分常會看到這個詞。

cues.en: The interval is basically just a range of x axis values that we are considering.
cues.zh: 區間基本上是我們考慮的一段 x 軸值。

cues.en: You can also think of this as a subdomain for this particular problem.
cues.zh: 也能想成這個問題的子定義域。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now the intermediate value theorem states that any given value, any number between four and 16 has
cues.zh: 所以介值定理說，四到十六之間任何數字，都有，

cues.en: a corresponding x axis value between two and four.
cues.zh: 二到四之間對應的 x。

cues.en: So just to pick a pretty simple example is nine, nine is between four and 16.
cues.zh: 簡單例子，九介於四、十六。

cues.en: And so the intermediate value theorem tells us that the corresponding x axis value to produce an F of x equals nine must be between two and four.
cues.zh: 所以要產生 f(x)=9，對應 x 必須在二、四之間。

cues.en: And obviously that is the case.
cues.zh: 顯然如此。

cues.en: It's the number three in this case.
cues.zh: 這裡就是三。

cues.en: So and that holds for all of the numbers between four and 16, they will all have some corresponding x axis value that is between two and four.
cues.zh: 四到十六全部數字都成立，都有某個二到四之間的對應 x。

cues.en: Now, do you think that this theorem, as I've described it so far, is necessarily always true?
cues.zh: 到目前為止的描述，一定總成立嗎？

cues.en: Can you think of any counterexamples where this theorem does not hold?
cues.zh: 想得到不成立的反例嗎？

cues.en: Let me rephrase that question.
cues.zh: 換個方式問。

cues.en: Can you come up with a function where it is not the case that every value between F of A and F of B
cues.zh: 能找出函數，不是每個 f(a)、f(b) 之間的值，

cues.en: exists and has some corresponding x axis value?
cues.zh: 都存在、都有對應 x？

cues.en: So I'm going to give one possible answer on the following slide.
cues.zh: 下一張會提供一個答案。

cues.en: So feel free to pause the video here if you want some more time to think about it.
cues.zh: 想多思考，可以先暫停。

cues.en: So here is a counterexample and that's a piecewise function.
cues.zh: 反例是分段函數。

cues.en: So let's take this function now as a perfectly reasonable function.
cues.zh: 這是很合理的函數。

cues.en: There's nothing wrong with it, but there is a jump discontinuity over here.
cues.zh: 沒問題，但這裡有跳躍不連續。

cues.en: So it is not the case that every value between F of A and F of B is in the function.
cues.zh: 所以不是 f(a)、f(b) 之間每個值，都在函數中。

cues.en: And therefore also it is not the case that every number between F of A and F of B has a corresponding x axis value between A and B.
cues.zh: 因此也不是每個值，都有 a、b 之間的對應 x。

cues.en: So did you also come up with a piecewise function with a jump discontinuity as your counterexample?
cues.zh: 你也想到有跳躍不連續的分段函數嗎？

cues.en: Maybe you did, or maybe you came up with a different kind of function that also has a jump discontinuity or perhaps a removable discontinuity.
cues.zh: 也許是，或其他有跳躍，甚至可去不連續的函數。

cues.en: In fact, any kind of discontinuity will break the intermediate value theorem.
cues.zh: 其實任何不連續都會破壞介值定理。

cues.en: So in fact, the intermediate value theorem requires that the function is continuous within the specified interval.
cues.zh: 所以介值定理要求，函數在指定區間內連續。

cues.en: And with that in mind, here's the formal definition.
cues.zh: 記住這點，正式定義如下。

cues.en: So the formal definition of the intermediate value theorem is that if a function is continuous in the
cues.zh: 如果函數在，

cues.en: interval of A to B, then all values between F of A and F of B are present at least once in that function.
cues.zh: a 到 b 區間連續，那 f(a)、f(b) 之間所有值，在函數中至少出現一次。

cues.en: But what's the big deal of the intermediate value theorem?
cues.zh: 但介值定理有什麼了不起？

cues.en: Why do we care about this kind of a claim?
cues.zh: 為什麼在意這種主張？

cues.en: Well, for one thing, it's used in other theorems and proofs later on in calculus that you will see in this course and also other proofs.
cues.zh: 首先，後面的微積分定理、證明，這門課和其他證明都會用。

cues.en: But another important application is finding whether a polynomial equation has a certain set of solutions.
cues.zh: 另一個重要應用，是判斷多項式方程式是否有某組解。

cues.en: So there are many situations where we want to determine the roots of.
cues.zh: 很多情況，要找多項式，

cues.en: A polynomial equation.
cues.zh: 方程式的根。

cues.en: So the roots of a polynomial are the solutions to X when you set the equation to zero.
cues.zh: 根就是把方程式設為零時，x 的解。

cues.en: So imagine setting this equation to zero and solving for x.
cues.zh: 想像設這個式子為零，再解 x。

cues.en: All of those solutions are called the roots of this polynomial equation.
cues.zh: 全部解，都叫這個多項式方程式的根。

cues.en: Finding the roots of a polynomial is really important for lots of applications like eigenvalue, decomposition statistics, a lot of other areas in applied math.
cues.zh: 求根在特徵值分解、統計，以及許多應用數學領域都很重要。

cues.en: So how do we use the intermediate value theorem here?
cues.zh: 如何用介值定理？

cues.en: Well, if we can find a value of x that makes this equation equal some negative number and some other
cues.zh: 若能找到一個 x，讓式子為負，再找另一個，

cues.en: value of x that makes this equation equal, some positive number, then it must be the case that there is at least one value of x, which makes this equation equal zero.
cues.zh: x，讓它為正，就一定至少有一個 x，讓式子等於零。

cues.en: And that's because zero is in between any negative number, in any positive number.
cues.zh: 因為零介於任何負數與正數之間。

cues.en: And so in fact, from these two equations, we can use the intermediate value theorem to determine that this function has real valued roots.
cues.zh: 所以對這兩個式子，可以用介值定理，判斷這個函數有實根。

cues.en: This has solutions to setting this equation to zero, whereas this equation does not have any real value solutions.
cues.zh: 把這個方程式設零有解，另一個沒有實數解。

cues.en: Well, that may seem a little bizarre because these functions are almost identical, except for this tiny little difference in the y axis offset.
cues.zh: 可能有點奇怪，兩函數幾乎相同，只是 y 軸位移有小差別。

cues.en: But this equation can be solved for some negative numbers, whereas this one cannot.
cues.zh: 但這個式子能取某些負值，另一個不能。

cues.en: And how did I do that?
cues.zh: 怎麼做到？

cues.en: I was just some crazy math genius, and I just figured out that this can be solved for negative numbers and this cannot.
cues.zh: 我是瘋狂數學天才，直接看出這個能為負、那個不能？

cues.en: The answer is no.
cues.zh: 不是。

cues.en: I'm definitely not some crazy math genius.
cues.zh: 我絕對不是數學天才。

cues.en: In fact, what I did was to compute the derivative of these two functions, set the derivative to zero,
cues.zh: 其實是算兩函數導數，把導數設為零，

cues.en: and then plugged in the real value roots of the derivative into this original equation.
cues.zh: 再把導數的實根，代回原式。

cues.en: Now, that might sound like a bunch of confusing nonsense, but it's actually a pretty straightforward application of the derivative, and I promise it will make sense later in the course.
cues.zh: 聽起來可能一堆混亂廢話，但其實是直接的導數應用，後面會理解。

cues.en: After learning about derivatives and in particular on the section on applications of the derivative.
cues.zh: 學導數之後，尤其導數應用章節。

cues.en: Okay, So in this video, I introduce you to the intermediate value theorem.
cues.zh: 好，這支介紹介值定理。

cues.en: It has a formal definition and a condition for its validity, but I think it's a fairly intuitive theorem to understand.
cues.zh: 有正式定義和成立條件，但我覺得相當直觀、容易理解。
